uutiset.t: Asian Stock Futures Signal Gains, Oil Climbs Again: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: Asian stocks may look to build on a tech rally that powered gains in US stock futures on Thursday, with signs of a revival in risk appetite lifting assets including copper and Bitcoin. Oil climbed after Yemen’s Houthi rebels struck a key Saudi Refinery.

uutiset.t: Ford CEO on Le Mans, New Electric Pickup and Trade Talks
uutiset.s: Bloomberg’s Matt Miller sits down with Ford CEO Jim Farley to talk racing, Ford’s planned $30,000 electric pickup, Chinese EV competition and USMCA trade talks, zeroing in on how to protect US auto manufacturing while competing on a global stage. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Ghana Buys Back $1.1 Billion Domestic Bonds to Boost Confidence
uutiset.s: Ghana redeemed a four-year domestic bond three months ahead of maturity, as the government sought to bolster investor confidence in an economy recovering from a debt restructuring.

uutiset.t: New Zealand Poised to Learn Who Can Form Its Next Government
uutiset.s: New Zealand will learn Friday who is in a position to form its next government, three weeks after an election that was too close to call.

uutiset.t: KKR Banks Line Up €550 Million of Debt to Back Logoplaste Buyout
uutiset.s: Banks have lined up €550 million ($603.5 million) of loans to back KKR & Co.’s acquisition of packaging company Logoplaste, according to people familiar with the situation.

uutiset.t: Kazakhstan Encouraged Local Banks to Finance Deal for Gold Miner
uutiset.s: Kazakhstan has encouraged domestic banks to lend more than $1 billion to construction tycoon Shakhmurat Mutalip and revised financing regulations to help him buy gold miner AK Altynalmas JSC, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Stellantis to Pause More Europe Plants as Chinese Rivals Advance
uutiset.s: Stellantis NV is planning further plant stoppages in Europe in the coming weeks as the carmaker grapples with mounting competition, high costs and weak demand for some models.

uutiset.t: Trans-Oil Warns of Going-Concern Risk Pending Debt Waiver
uutiset.s: Trans-Oil Group has yet to secure a waiver after breaching financial covenants on a key export facility, adding to liquidity pressure at the agricultural commodities firm.

uutiset.t: Wall Street se vuelve más cauteloso con el carry trade
uutiset.s: La operación llegó a generar retornos cercanos a 20% y resistió guerras, intervenciones y crisis políticas. Ahora, la volatilidad obliga a repensar una de las maniobras favoritas del mercado.

uutiset.t: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
uutiset.s: Democratic Republic of Congo’s state gold trader plans to build two refineries with capacity for 68 tons as the country looks to curb smuggling and profit more from its reserves of the precious metal.

uutiset.t: Bawag’s €1.6 Billion PTSB Deal Rejected by Irish High Court
uutiset.s: The Irish High Court declined to approve Bawag Group AG’s takeover of Irish lender Permanent TSB Group Holdings Plc, saying that the Austrian bank must also seek approval of minority shareholders.

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso in Worst Losing Streak in Years on Carry Unwind
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso posted its longest losing streak in five years on Thursday as investors flee to safe haven assets and the popular carry trade unravels.

uutiset.t: Australia Passes Gas Reserve Law in Upset to LNG Exporters
uutiset.s: Australia adopted a law requiring liquefied natural gas exporters to reserve as much as a fifth of their supply for the domestic market.

uutiset.t: Altria, Japan Tobacco Explore Takeover of Imperial Brands
uutiset.s: Altria Group Inc. and Japan Tobacco Inc. are exploring a potential takeover of British cigarette maker Imperial Brands Plc, accelerating consolidation in the declining cigarette market in what would be one of the biggest UK acquisitions in a decade.

uutiset.t: UBS Vows to Remain Global as Swiss Capital Outlook Darkens
uutiset.s: UBS Group AG’s top leadership sought to reassure staff that Switzerland’s effort to tighten regulation won’t take away something the bank has been building for decades — a truly global business.
